messages:
mira: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread. We keep seeing a pattern where feature flags jump from 0->100 too quickly and our canary automation sometimes fails to rollback fast enough. Need a concise remediation plan with owners + dates.

jamal: I can own the rollout safety playbook. Thinking: enforce a default max_audience_pct, require a runtime validation step on flag creation, and add a "safety circuit" in the rollout controller. Will draft a checklist today.

sophie: I'll own the observability pieces. Missing signal combinations (small error spikes + tail latency) were hard to detect. I'll add a composite alert and a per-flag timeline view. ETA: next Tue.

kai: I'll take auto-rollback hardening. Ideas:
- add hysteresis to avoid flapping
- require two-window confirmation (1-min aggregate + 5-min aggregate)
- tie rollback to both error-rate and token-drop metrics
I'll open a spec PR by Fri.

ops-bot: Incident linked: INC-2026-322. Watchers: @mira @jamal.

mira: Concrete action items I'm adding to the tracker now: 
- Jamal: rollout safety playbook (includes flag create validation + CLI guard) (due 2026-04-06)
- Sophie: composite alerts + per-flag dashboard + runbook (due 2026-04-01)
- Kai: rollback controller hysteresis + 2-window confirmation + tests (due 2026-04-08)
- Mira: follow-up audit of recent flags and retro checklist (due 2026-03-29)

jamal: For the flag create flow I propose the API requires either max_audience_pct or explicit "staged_steps". Default behavior should refuse a flag without limits. Also add a CLI prompt when creating a new flag in prod.

sophie: One more: add a canary traffic generator job that runs a representative prompt set against the canary pool every deploy. It should fail the rollout if latency or CLI mismatch exceed thresholds. I'll pair with QA to author the prompt set.

kai: Good. For rollback triggers, propose this simple rule for now:
```
trigger rollback if (error_rate_in_window > 0.4%) && (p95_tokens > 900ms || token_drop_rate > 0.2%)
```
Add a 90s cooldown then verify with a 2-min confirmation.

mira: Noted. We should also require a human approval step for flags that target >5% until we've proven auto-rollback reliability. Add to playbook.

jamal: I'll include a policy in the playbook: flags >5% require a secondary approver from Eng SRE.

sophie: Ops ask: can someone add trace sampling for canary requests at 100% to help triage? Right now traces are sparse.

kai: I'll update the rollout controller to mark canary requests with trace tag and increase sampling when a canary is active.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: rollout-controller PR #842 by kai. CI tests running.

mira: Meeting to align on signoffs tomorrow 09:30. We'll review the playbook, runbook, and the CI smoke-test plan. If you can't make it, drop comments on the PRs.

jamal: Adding a small checklist to the postmortem doc: audit last 30 flags, backfill alerts where missing, QA smoke test, infra capacity check for canary traffic.

sophie: I'll prepare the dashboard mockups and a short runbook blurb.

kai: CI passed for the initial tests. PR has basic unit tests + one integration smoke that simulates error spike. Please review.

mira: Thanks all. Let's aim to close blockers in the action tracker within the dates above. We'll reconvene in a week for status.
